body.id: Menghormati yang lebih tua: menyapa lebih dulu, mendengarkan, dan memberi tempat.
body.en: Respecting elders: greet first, listen and make room.

body.id: Menghormati yang berbeda — suku, agama, logat, atau kebiasaan — berarti tidak mengejek dan memberi ruang.
body.en: Respecting difference — ethnicity, faith, accent or custom — means no mockery and making room.

body.id: Tepat waktu menghargai waktu orang lain. Jika akan terlambat, kabari sebelum jam janji.
body.en: Being on time respects other people's time. If you'll be late, say so before the agreed time.

body.id: Gotong royong: banyak tangan membuat pekerjaan berat menjadi ringan.
body.en: Gotong royong: many hands make heavy work light.

body.id: Setiap orang bisa menyumbang sesuai kemampuan: tenaga, makanan, alat, atau waktu.
body.en: Everyone can give what they can: effort, food, tools or time.

body.id: Janjikan yang sanggup Anda lakukan. Jika harus berubah, kabari lebih awal dan tawarkan jalan keluar.
body.en: Promise what you can do. If it has to change, say so early and offer another way.

caption.id: Rapat RT dijadwalkan pukul 19.00. Pak Hendra datang sepuluh menit lebih awal.
caption.en: The neighbourhood meeting was set for 7 p.m. Pak Hendra arrived ten minutes early.

caption.id: Pukul tujuh, baru lima warga yang hadir. Yang lain masih di jalan.
caption.en: At seven, only five residents were there. The rest were still on their way.

caption.id: Pak Hendra tetap memulai tepat waktu dan membahas hal terpenting lebih dulu.
caption.en: Pak Hendra started on time anyway and covered the most important points first.

caption.id: Rapat selesai pukul 20.00, sesuai janji. Bulan berikutnya, lebih banyak warga datang tepat waktu.
caption.en: The meeting ended at 8 p.m., as promised. The next month, more residents came on time.

caption.id: Pak Yusuf berjanji membantu Bu Meri membersihkan talang air hari Minggu.
caption.en: Pak Yusuf promised to help Bu Meri clear her roof gutter on Sunday.

caption.id: Sabtu siang, kantornya meminta ia bekerja pada hari Minggu.
caption.en: On Saturday afternoon, his office asked him to work on Sunday.

caption.id: Ia langsung mengabari Bu Meri dan menawarkan Sabtu sore.
caption.en: He told Bu Meri right away and offered Saturday afternoon instead.

caption.id: Sabtu sore, dua tetangga ikut membantu. Talang bersih sebelum hujan turun.
caption.en: On Saturday afternoon, two more neighbours joined in. The gutter was clear before the rain came.

meaning.id: Di bus yang penuh, seorang nenek naik membawa belanjaan.
meaning.en: On a full bus, an elderly woman gets on with her shopping.

model_answer.id: Tempat duduk adalah hormat yang paling terasa bagi lansia yang membawa barang.
model_answer.en: A seat is the most practical respect you can offer an older person carrying bags.

meaning.id: Mana yang menghormati, mana yang kurang?
meaning.en: Which show respect, and which don't?

text.id: Mengirim lelucon yang mengejek suku lain
text.en: Sending a joke that mocks another ethnic group

text.id: Makan bersama rekan yang berbeda latar
text.en: Eating with colleagues from different backgrounds
Leaving a colleague out because of their accent

text.id: Mendengarkan cerita orang yang lebih tua
text.en: Listening to an older person's story

model_answer.id: Hormat tampak dari sapaan, kesediaan mendengar, dan tidak mengejek atau mengucilkan siapa pun.
model_answer.en: Respect shows in greetings, in listening, and in never mocking or excluding anyone.

meaning.id: Pasangkan orangnya dengan sikap yang menghormati.
meaning.en: Match each person with a respectful approach.

text.en: A grandfather who is hard of hearing

text.id: Rekan yang merayakan hari raya berbeda
text.en: A colleague who celebrates a different holiday

text.id: Bicara pelan dan jelas, beri waktu menjawab
text.en: Speak slowly and clearly, give him time to answer

text.id: Jangan jadwalkan rapat pada hari rayanya
text.en: Don't schedule meetings on their holiday
Visit briefly and keep it quiet

model_answer.id: Hormat menyesuaikan diri dengan orangnya: kakek perlu waktu, hari raya rekan perlu dihargai, yang sakit perlu istirahat.
model_answer.en: Respect fits the person: a grandfather needs time, a colleague's holiday deserves honouring, someone ill needs rest.

meaning.id: Menghormati keyakinan orang lain berarti harus ikut menjalankannya.
meaning.en: Respecting someone's beliefs means you have to practise them too.

model_answer.id: Menghormati berarti tidak mengganggu, tidak mengejek, dan memberi ruang. Anda tidak harus ikut menjalankannya.
model_answer.en: Respect means not disturbing, not mocking and making room. You don't have to practise it yourself.

meaning.id: Rekan baru dari daerah lain berbicara dengan logat yang berbeda.
meaning.en: A new colleague from another region speaks with a different accent.

text.id: Menirukan logatnya di grup untuk bahan tertawaan
text.en: Mimicking the accent in a group chat for laughs

model_answer.id: Logat adalah bagian dari asal seseorang. Mendengarkan dengan sungguh-sungguh membuatnya merasa diterima.
model_answer.en: An accent is part of where someone comes from. Listening properly makes them feel welcome.

meaning.id: Urutan bertamu ke rumah orang yang lebih tua.
meaning.en: The steps of visiting an older person's home.

text.en: Knocking and calling out a greeting

model_answer.id: Ketuk dan ucapkan salam, salami tuan rumah, dengarkan, lalu berpamitan dengan sopan.
model_answer.en: Knock and call out a greeting, shake the host's hand, listen, then take your leave politely.

model_answer.id: Rapat mulai dan selesai tepat waktu; bulan berikutnya, lebih banyak warga datang tepat waktu.
model_answer.en: The meeting started and ended on time; the next month, more residents came on time.

meaning.id: Mengapa bulan berikutnya lebih banyak warga datang tepat waktu?
meaning.en: Why did more residents come on time the next month?

text.en: They were afraid Pak Hendra would tell them off
The meeting was moved to the daytime

text.id: Mereka tahu rapat mulai dan selesai sesuai jadwal
text.en: They knew the meeting would start and end on schedule

model_answer.id: Jadwal yang selalu ditepati membuat orang percaya bahwa datang tepat waktu ada gunanya.
model_answer.en: A schedule that's always kept makes people trust that being on time is worth it.

meaning.id: Rapat pukul 09.00, perjalanan 30 menit, dan jalan sering macet. Kapan berangkat?
meaning.en: The meeting is at 9:00, the trip takes 30 minutes and traffic is unpredictable. When do you leave?

model_answer.id: Berangkat 08.00 memberi cadangan 30 menit untuk macet. Berangkat 08.30 berarti tidak ada ruang untuk kejutan.
model_answer.en: Leaving at 8:00 gives a 30-minute buffer for traffic. Leaving at 8:30 leaves no room for surprises.

meaning.id: Malam dan pagi sebelum janji penting: mana yang membantu?
meaning.en: The night and morning before an important appointment: what helps?

text.en: Getting absorbed in your phone before leaving

model_answer.id: Tidur cukup dan bersiap lebih awal memudahkan tepat waktu; layar sampai larut dan ponsel di pagi hari mencuri waktu.
model_answer.en: Enough sleep and getting ready early help; late-night screens and morning scrolling steal time.

meaning.id: Anda akan terlambat 15 menit ke janji dengan teman.
meaning.en: You're going to be 15 minutes late meeting a friend.

text.en: Blaming the traffic when you arrive

model_answer.id: Kabar sebelum jam janji memberi teman pilihan: menunggu, memesan dulu, atau mengatur ulang.
model_answer.en: A message before the time gives your friend options: wait, order first or rearrange.

meaning.id: Pasangkan gambar dan nilainya.
meaning.en: Match each picture to its value.

model_answer.id: Tepat waktu, hormat, toleran, mau mendengar: cara-cara menghargai orang lain.
model_answer.en: Punctual, respectful, tolerant, willing to listen: ways of valuing others.

meaning.id: Seorang lansia kebingungan mencari peron di stasiun.
meaning.en: An older man looks lost trying to find his platform.

text.en: Walking him to the right platform

model_answer.id: Beberapa menit bantuan bisa membuatnya tidak ketinggalan kereta.
model_answer.en: A few minutes of help could stop him missing his train.

meaning.id: Mengabari bahwa Anda terlambat sama baiknya dengan datang tepat waktu.
meaning.en: Letting someone know you'll be late is just as good as being on time.

model_answer.id: Kabar itu sopan, tetapi waktu orang lain tetap terbuang. Usahakan tepat waktu; kabar adalah rencana cadangan.
model_answer.en: A message is polite, but their time is still lost. Aim to be on time; a message is the backup plan.

meaning.id: Selokan di gang Anda tersumbat menjelang musim hujan.
meaning.en: The drain in your lane is blocked just before the rainy season.

text.en: Getting the neighbours together to clear it
Throwing more rubbish into the drain

model_answer.id: Kerja bakti menyelesaikan masalah bersama sebelum hujan datang; mengeluh saja tidak membersihkan selokan.
model_answer.en: Working together sorts it out before the rain comes; complaining alone doesn't clear the drain.

meaning.id: Saat kerja bakti: mana yang membantu?
meaning.en: During a community clean-up: what helps?

text.en: Turning up when it's nearly done
Mocking the organisers in the group chat
Helping a neighbour lift something heavy
Leaving one person to work alone

model_answer.id: Gotong royong hidup dari kehadiran, berbagi tugas, dan saling menyemangati.
model_answer.en: Gotong royong lives on showing up, sharing tasks and encouraging each other.

meaning.id: Urutan kerja bakti di lingkungan.
meaning.en: The steps of a neighbourhood clean-up.

model_answer.id: Ajak, bagi tugas, kerjakan bersama, lalu makan bersama — kebersamaan itu ikut menguatkan lingkungan.
model_answer.en: Invite, divide the work, do it together, then eat together — that time together strengthens the neighbourhood too.

meaning.id: Pasangkan situasi dengan bantuan yang pas.
meaning.en: Match each situation with the right kind of help.

text.en: A tree has fallen after a storm
Clear the branches off the road together

model_answer.id: Gotong royong menyesuaikan kebutuhan: makanan untuk yang sakit, tenaga untuk yang pindahan, kerja bersama setelah badai.
model_answer.en: Gotong royong fits the need: meals for the sick, muscle for a move, teamwork after a storm.

meaning.id: Dalam gotong royong, setiap orang harus menyumbang dengan cara yang sama.
meaning.en: In gotong royong, everyone has to contribute in the same way.

model_answer.id: Setiap orang menyumbang sesuai kemampuan: tenaga, makanan, alat, atau waktu.
model_answer.en: Everyone gives what they can: effort, food, tools or time.

meaning.id: Acara 17-an selesai dan kursi masih berserakan di lapangan.
meaning.en: The Independence Day event is over and chairs are scattered across the field.

text.en: Turning up when it's all done
Leaving plastic cups on the field

model_answer.id: Beres-beres bersama membuat pekerjaan cepat selesai dan tidak hanya membebani panitia.
model_answer.en: Clearing up together gets it done fast and doesn't leave it all to the organisers.

model_answer.id: Pak Yusuf mengabari lebih awal, menawarkan waktu pengganti, dan menepatinya.
model_answer.en: Pak Yusuf told her early, offered another time and kept it.

meaning.id: Setelah kantornya menelepon, langkah Pak Yusuf mana yang paling membantu?
meaning.en: After his office called, which step of Pak Yusuf's helped most?

text.en: Turning up on Sunday evening without a word

text.id: Diam dan berharap Bu Meri lupa
text.en: Saying nothing and hoping she'd forget

model_answer.id: Kabar lebih awal memberi Bu Meri waktu mengatur ulang, dan janji pengganti tetap ditepati.
model_answer.en: Telling her early gave Bu Meri time to rearrange, and the new plan was kept.

meaning.id: Rekan minta bantuan untuk tugas mendesak. Janji mana yang paling bisa dipegang?
meaning.en: A colleague needs help with an urgent task. Which promise can they rely on most?

model_answer.id: Janji yang jelas waktunya dan masuk akal mudah ditepati. «Nanti» terlalu samar; «semua malam ini» berisiko tidak tercapai.
model_answer.en: A promise with a clear, realistic time is easy to keep. "Later" is too vague; "the whole lot tonight" may not happen.

meaning.id: Urutan meminjam barang tetangga.
meaning.en: The steps of borrowing a neighbour's things.

model_answer.id: Minta izin, pakai dengan hati-hati, kembalikan sesuai janji, dan berterima kasih — tetangga akan senang meminjamkan lagi.
model_answer.en: Ask, use it carefully, return it when promised and say thanks — your neighbour will happily lend again.

meaning.id: Pasangkan gambar dan nilainya.
meaning.en: Match each picture to its value.

model_answer.id: Gotong royong, tepat janji, berbagi, dan peduli membuat tetangga bisa saling mengandalkan.
model_answer.en: Gotong royong, keeping your word, sharing and caring let neighbours rely on each other.

meaning.id: Tetangga meminjamkan tangganya kepada Anda sampai hari Sabtu.
meaning.en: A neighbour has lent you their ladder until Saturday.

model_answer.id: Mengembalikan tepat waktu dan bersih berarti menepati janji — dan tetangga mau meminjamkan lagi.
model_answer.en: Returning it on time and clean keeps your promise — and they'll lend to you again.

meaning.id: Rumah tetangga kebanjiran dan warga mengumpulkan bantuan.
meaning.en: A neighbour's house has flooded and residents are collecting help.

text.id: Tidak peduli karena bukan urusan sendiri
text.en: Ignoring it as none of your business

text.id: Menyebar kabar belum pasti tentang korban
text.en: Spreading unconfirmed rumours about the family

text.id: Mengantar makanan dan pakaian layak pakai
text.en: Bringing food and good used clothes

model_answer.id: Bantuan nyata dan kata-kata yang hati-hati meringankan beban korban.
model_answer.en: Practical help and careful words ease the family's burden.

meaning.id: Jika janji harus batal, mengabari setelah waktunya lewat sudah cukup.
meaning.en: If you have to cancel, letting them know after the time has passed is good enough.

model_answer.id: Kabari sebelum waktunya agar orang lain sempat mengatur ulang. Kabar yang terlambat tetap membuang waktunya.
model_answer.en: Tell them before the time so they can rearrange. A late message still wastes their time.

items.source: Charities Aid Foundation (2024). World Giving Index 2024: Global perspectives on generosity. London: CAF (rilis 21 Agustus 2024), www.cafonline.org

model_answer.id: Dalam World Giving Index 2024 dari Charities Aid Foundation (CAF), Indonesia menjadi negara paling dermawan di dunia, tujuh tahun berturut-turut. Sekitar 9 dari 10 responden Indonesia menyumbang uang dalam sebulan sebelum survei, dan 65% menjadi relawan.
model_answer.en: In the Charities Aid Foundation's World Giving Index 2024, Indonesia was the world's most generous country for the seventh year in a row. About 9 in 10 Indonesian respondents had given money in the month before the survey, and 65% had volunteered.

meaning.id: Rapat RT pukul 19.30. Perjalanan 20 menit, dan Anda ingin tiba 10 menit lebih awal. Paling lambat berangkat pukul berapa?
meaning.en: The meeting is at 7:30 p.m. The trip takes 20 minutes and you want to arrive 10 minutes early. What's the latest you can leave?

model_answer.en: 7:30 − 10 minutes − 20 minutes = 7:00 p.m.
